41:2: It is a revelation from the Rahman and the Rahim.
41:3: A book whose verses have been explained for a people who know, as an Arabic Qur'an, a bringer of glad tidings and a warner.
41:4: As a bringer of glad tidings and a warner. But most of them turned away, so they do not hear.
41:5: And they said: Our hearts are within coverings from that which you call us to, and in our ears is a heaviness, and between us and you is a veil. So work, surely we too are workers.
41:6: Say: I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your god is one god. So turn to Him and ask forgiveness from Him.
41:7: Those who do not give the zakat, and they are the deniers of the Hereafter.
41:8: Surely for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there is an uninterrupted reward.
41:9: Say: Do you indeed disbelieve in the One Who created the earth in two days and set up equals to Him? That is the Rabb of the worlds.
41:10: And He placed in it mountains from above it, placed blessings in it, and decreed in it its provisions in four days, equal for those who ask.
41:11: Then He turned to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth: Come, willingly or unwillingly. They said: We have come obediently.
41:12: Thus He completed them as seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its command. And We adorned the heaven of the world with lamps and protected it. That is the decree of the Aziz, the Alim.
41:13: If they turn away, then say: I have warned you with a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt of Ad and Thamud.
41:14: When the messengers came to them from before them and from behind them, saying: Do not worship any other than Allah. They said: If our Rabb had willed, He would have sent down angels. Surely we are deniers of that with which you were sent.
41:15: As for the people of Ad, they acted arrogantly on the earth without right and said: Who is stronger than us? Did they not see that Allah, Who created them, is stronger than them? And they were denying Our verses.
41:16: Thus We sent upon them a freezing wind on ominous days to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life, and the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly more disgraceful, and they will not be helped.
41:17: And as for Thamud, We showed them the right way, but they loved blindness over guidance; then the thunderbolt of the humiliating punishment seized them because of the things they used to earn.
41:18: And We saved those who believed and were guarding (against evil).
41:19: And that day the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire; they will be driven.
41:20: Until when they come to it, their hearing, their sights, and their skins will testify against them concerning the things they used to do.
41:21: They will say to their skins: Why did you testify against us? They will say: Allah, Who made everything speak, has made us speak. It is He Who created you the first time, and to Him you are being returned.
41:22: And you were not concealing yourselves from your ears, your eyes, and your skins testifying against you, but you thought that Allah did not know much.
41:23: And that thought of yours which you assumed about your Rabb destroyed you, and you became among the losers.
41:24: If they endure patiently, the Fire is an abode for them; and if they ask to be appeased, they are not of those who are appeased.
41:25: We assigned companions for them, and they adorned for them what was before them and what was behind them. And the word came true against them among the communities of jinn and humans that had passed away before them. Surely they were the losers.
41:26: Those who disbelieved said: Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak vain words in it, so that perhaps you may overcome.
41:27: We will surely make those who disbelieve taste a severe punishment, and We will recompense them with the worst of what they used to do.
41:28: That is the punishment of the enemies of Allah: the Fire; in return for their denying Our verses, there is for them in it the abode of eternity.
41:29: Those who disbelieved said: Our Rabb, show us those from among the jinn and humans who led us astray so that we may place them under our feet that they may be among the lowest.
41:30: Surely those who say, 'Our Rabb is Allah,' and then remain steadfast, upon them angels descend, saying: Do not fear, do not grieve, and rejoice with the Paradise that you were promised.
41:31: We are your friends in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. In it is everything your souls desire for you, and in it is everything you ask for you.
41:32: As hospitality from the One Who is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
41:33: And who is better in speech than the one who calls to Allah, does righteous deeds, and says, 'Surely I am of the Muslims'?
41:34: Goodness and evil are not equal. Repel with that which is best. Then the one between whom and you was enmity becomes as if he were an intimate friend.
41:35: And none is made to attain it except those who are patient, and none is made to attain it except the possessor of a great share.
41:36: And if a prompting from Satan reaches you, immediately seek refuge in Allah, because He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
41:37: The night and the day, the sun and the moon are among His verses. Do not prostrate to the sun nor to the moon; prostrate to the One Who created them, if it is Him you worship.
41:38: If they act arrogantly, then those who are in the presence of your Rabb glorify Him night and day, and they do not grow weary.
41:39: And among His verses is that you see the earth humbled (dry); when We send down water upon it, it stirs and swells. Surely the One Who gives it life is also the Giver of life to the dead. Surely He is capable of all things.
41:40: Surely those who deviate concerning Our verses are not hidden from Us. Is he who is cast into the Fire better, or he who comes in safety on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you wish; surely He is All-Seeing of what you do.
41:41: Surely those who disbelieved in the Reminder when it came to them; and surely it is a mighty book.
41:42: Falsehood can come to it neither from before it nor from behind it. It is sent down from the One Who is Wise, Praiseworthy.
41:43: Nothing is said to you except what was said to the messengers before you. Surely your Rabb is the possessor of forgiveness and the possessor of a painful punishment.
41:44: If We had made it a foreign Qur'an, they would have said: 'Should its verses not have been explained? Foreign and Arabic?' Say: 'It is a guidance and a healing for those who believe.' In the ears of those who do not believe there is a heaviness, and it is blindness upon them. Those are called from a distant place.
41:45: And certainly We gave Moses the Book, but dispute arose concerning it. If a word had not previously gone forth from your Rabb, it would certainly have been judged between them.
41:46: Whoever does a righteous deed, it is for his own benefit, and whoever does evil, it is against himself; and your Rabb is not unjust to the servants.
41:47: The knowledge of the Hour of Resurrection is returned to Him. No fruit emerges from its sheaths, no female conceives and gives birth except by His knowledge. And the Day He calls out to them: 'Where are My partners?' they say: 'We declared to You, there is no witness among us.'
41:48: The things they used to keep supplicating beforehand were lost from them, and they understood that there was no escape for them.
41:49: Man does not tire of praying for good. If evil touches him, he immediately becomes hopeless and despairing.
41:50: And if We make him taste a mercy from Us after a harm that touched him, he surely says: 'This is for me. And I do not think that the Hour will occur.' And if I am returned to my Rabb, undoubtedly in His presence there is the best for me. And We will surely inform those who disbelieved of what they did, and We will make them taste of a severe punishment.
41:51: When We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and turns aside; and when evil touches him, he is possessor of an extensive prayer.
41:52: Say: 'Have you seen: if it is from Allah, and then you disbelieved in it, who is more astray than one who is in a far separation?'
41:53: We will show them Our signs on the horizons and in their own selves so that it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. Is your Rabb not a witness over everything?
41:54: Take heed, undoubtedly they are in doubt about meeting their Rabb; take heed, undoubtedly He is the All-Encompassing of everything.
